1.explanation: TableBatchAction.js contains the defaultProps for iconDescription (currently set to 'Add') and the PropTypes clause that governs whether iconDescription is required. Changing defaultProps.iconDescription to '' and adjusting the PropTypes requirement (so it’s only required for icon‐only buttons) directly fixes the incorrect announcements. The two test files (the spec and its snapshot) reference that default and will need updating to assert against the new empty‐string default rather than 'Add'.
1.bug_scenario: When you use the TableBatchAction component without passing an explicit iconDescription, it currently falls back to the hard-coded default of “Add,” so screen readers announce “Edit Add Button,” “Reset Add Button,” etc., even though the visible label is “Edit” or “Reset.” If you explicitly pass iconDescription matching the visible label (for example, iconDescription="Edit"), screen readers then announce “Edit Edit Button” – a duplicate announcement. In both cases iconDescription is either wrong or redundant. The fix is to only require iconDescription when there is no visible label (i.e. icon‐only buttons), and to change the default value of iconDescription in TableBatchAction to an empty string so that visible-label buttons don’t get an incorrect default.

2.explanation:
1. TableBatchAction.js defines defaultProps.iconDescription = 'Add' and uses PropTypes.string.isRequired. This default causes screen readers to announce “Add” even when the visible label is present. The fix is to change the default to '' and make the prop conditionally required only when no children are provided.
2. TableBatchAction-test.js contains unit tests asserting the default behavior and PropTypes warnings. These tests must be updated to expect an empty default iconDescription when children exist and to require the prop only when children are missing.
2.bug_scenario:
When a TableBatchAction is rendered with both an icon and a visible label (children), the default iconDescription='Add' is still applied, causing screen readers (like JAWS) to read out “Edit Add Button” or “Reset Add Button.” Conversely, when no visible label is provided, callers must explicitly pass iconDescription='' to override the bad default of “Add.” The correct behavior is:
• If children (visible text label) exist, iconDescription should default to '' so it isn’t announced redundantly.
• If there are no children, iconDescription should be required to describe the icon-only button.
